routes.name: Russia e-visa
routes.summary: Single-entry e-visa for citizens of countries on a government-approved list. Stay is up to 30 days from entry. Apply 4 to 86 days before arrival.

other: Only citizens of countries on the Russian Government list. The list was not shown on the page.
Machine-readable passport valid at least 6 months from application date.
Medical insurance valid in Russia unless your country is exempt.
Each minor needs a separate e-visa.

stay.note: Visa valid 120 days from issue, single entry. Arrival and departure days both count.

steps: Apply at evisa.kdmid.ru no earlier than 86 days and no later than 4 days before entry.
Pay the processing fee by international bank card.
routes.processing: Within 4 calendar days of submission, per the portal.

routes.name: Regular Russian visa (tourist, business, private, work, study)
routes.summary: Most nationalities need a visa from a Russian embassy or consulate. Categories include tourist, business, private, work and study. Official pages with details could not be read, so confirm with the embassy.

other: Visa-free list and category rules not confirmed from an official page.
Details were not readable (embassy pages blocked automated access).

routes.name: Shared Values visa and temporary residence permit (Decree 702)
routes.summary: For citizens of countries on a government list who share Russian spiritual and moral values. Get a visa of up to 90 days, then apply for a temporary residence permit without quota or language, history and law tests for adults.

other: Citizen (or stateless resident) of a country on the Russian government list.
Must share Russian spiritual and moral values as described in Decree 702.
Police clearance certificate, apostilled and translated.
Medical certificates showing no drug use and no dangerous infections.
Children over 6 must attend in person; school enrollment needs Russian A2.

stay.note: Permit length not stated in the guide.

steps: Get a single-entry private visa (up to 90 days) or another valid visa.
Apply for the temporary residence permit at a migration center, Decree 702 window.
routes.processing: About 4 months after acceptance, per the guide.
